hec.model

Class SimulationRun

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.Observable
      • hec.lang.NamedType
        • hec.model.Manager
          • hec.model.SimulationRun
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    hec.csinterface.CallBackInterface, hec.event.ModifiableListener, AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, LockableObject, hec.map.MapObjectInterface, MessagePrinter, ModelConstants, TsRecordContainer, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.lang.Comparable, java.util.EventListener, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    RssSimRun, SimulationTrialRun

    public abstract class SimulationRun
extends Manager
implements AsciiSerializable, hec.map.MapObjectInterface, hec.event.ModifiableListener, ModelConstants
    Title: CWMS Development Project Description: Copyright: Copyright (c) 2001 Company: Resource Management Associates This is an abstract class that defines a Run in a simulation. All methods for creating trials, setting forecasts are defined by this class. This class must be sublcassed to define what trial class to use for trial runs and the model directory that will be used to store this run.
    Version:
    1.0
    Author:
    Shannon J. Newbold
